name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Hammer Preacher Curl
steps: Sit at a preacher bench and place the back of one upper arm snugly against the angled pad, holding a dumbbell with a neutral palm-in grip.
Keep your chest pressed lightly into the top edge of the pad and start with your working arm nearly extended.
Curl the dumbbell upward toward your shoulder while keeping your thumb pointed up and your upper arm pressed against the pad.
Lower the weight slowly back to the bottom stretch without locking out abruptly, and switch arms after finishing one side.
tips: Do not lift your elbow off the pad or lean backward to assist the curl.
Control the bottom of each repetition to protect the elbow joint and biceps tendon.
